notes: The three main numbered display equations are Dice, risk A and risk B. The two supplementary equations are the Kitagawa C and W terms placed with TableS12. No previous mathematical appendix or stale Eq4–14/S3–S12 reference remains.

All five formulas are editable native m:oMathPara display equations. Their borderless1x3 equation-layout containers are explicitly tagged and excluded from scientific data-table counts: main3 data tables/66cells plus3 equation layouts; supplement19 data tables/878cells plus2 equation layouts.

Each actual native formula was independently compared against the concise plan converted by Pandoc, retaining fraction scope, mathematical operators, subscripts, the four-direction sum limits and cohort signs. Upright method/cohort labels A/B/E/I are retained without changing the definitions.

Dice is restricted to a positive denominator in the leading prose; empty-empty predicted masks score1, and an empty prediction against the nonempty reference scores0. Risk A consumes raw model predictedIoU, while risk B compares the initial prediction with all four shifted predictions.

Verbatim baseline-method checks preserve the candidate/zero-review calibration rule, >= flagging, whole score ties, nearest20% target/fewer-at-tie selection, locked transfer, nearest-K/half-tie rule, original identifier-string ranking, H1–H3 directions and nominal Newcombe intervals.

Unchanged supplementary notes preserve paired-record and retained-repeat-draw handling, linear finite-value bootstrap quantiles, R1 empirical-support constraints, conditional equal-K intervals, zero-review-volume difference by design,4999/5000 valid decomposition draws, missing stratum rates even at zero weights and the separate historical versus six-case CPU environments.

Kitagawa displayed rates are fractions, and TableS12 differences are percentage points. The total identity is conditioned on defined stratum rates; overall rates are calculated from aggregate numerators/denominators and common-weight standardization is described in prose.

All66 main and878 supplementary scientific tablecells, main Results through declarations/references/captions, abstract/author metadata, all24 production figure files and the standalone S6 PDF bytes remain unchanged from the preceding revision.

Both actual proof pages were visually inspected here: three main equations on mainpage5 and two supplementary equations with TableS12 on supplementpage19. The moved qhat definition is complete, and fraction/percentage-point units are explicit. Full-page publication-layout review remains separately documented by the dedicated visual reviewer.

No model inference, patient resampling, new data collection, training or statistical reanalysis was run. Main21 pages, illustrated26, supplement25, standaloneS6six and concise equation prooftwo pages.
